_about: Registry of the AliExpress userscripts that install-userscripts and update-userscripts manage. Each script stamps its running version on <html> as the `stamp_attr` attribute (via GM_info), which is how an agent reads the installed version from a page without opening the Tampermonkey dashboard. `source_url` is what Tampermonkey installs from and polls through @updateURL. Updated 2026-10-26.

scripts.name: AliExpress — Hide Combo Deals (with Toggle)
scripts.effect: Search pages: a bar tagged USERSCRIPT above the grid with 'Show bundle deals' (off by default), a max-price slider (Any, $10-$70, $72; headroom under the $75 de-minimis), and a 'Choice All In' button applying Choice + Free shipping in one navigation.

scripts.name: AliExpress locale guard
scripts.effect: Puts the locale cookies back to EN/USD ship-to IL when the site drifts to HE/ILS. Optional: offer it, see set-locale.
scripts.caveat: Its preference lives in the WANT constant. An update replaces the file, so a user who edited WANT away from EN/USD must re-apply the edit after updating.

scripts.name: AliExpress — Find Similar (inline)
scripts.effect: Adds a Find Similar button to every product card.
scripts.caveat: The repo is private, so there is no URL Tampermonkey can install or update from. Detect it by page_marker only; install by pasting the file from a local clone.
